name: Electrocutioner 6000
summary: In Gnomeregan's Launch Bay, Electrocutioner 6000 guards the upper platform. The spider tank fights for Mekgineer Thermaplugg and the irradiated leper gnomes who follow him.

sections.title: Thermaplugg's Shocking Machine
sections.body: After Gnomeregan fell, Mekgineer Thermaplugg and the irradiated leper gnomes who follow him took control of the city's war machines. Electrocutioner 6000 guards the Launch Bay's upper platform. It strikes intruders with high-voltage current.

sections.title: The Workshop Key
sections.body: Electrocutioner 6000 guards the Workshop Key, which opens Gnomeregan's back door into its workshops. Bring down the machine, and the key gives you a quicker route into the city's depths.

faq.q: Where can the Electrocutioner 6000 be found?
faq.answer: Electrocutioner 6000 stands on an elevated catwalk platform overlooking Gnomeregan's Launch Bay.
No pilot is named in the accounts of Gnomeregan's fall. Electrocutioner 6000 fights for Mekgineer Thermaplugg and the leper gnomes who follow him.

faq.q: Why is the machine so volatile?
faq.answer: Its armored chassis channels high-voltage current and unleashes it on anyone who comes near. That makes Electrocutioner 6000 a dangerous guardian of the Launch Bay.

faq.q: Why is defeating the Electrocutioner 6000 important for explorers?
faq.answer: Electrocutioner 6000 guards the Workshop Key, which opens Gnomeregan's back door into its deeper engineering sectors. The key gives you a faster route through the facilities.

faq.q: Is the Electrocutioner an automaton or a vehicle?
faq.answer: Electrocutioner 6000 is a mechano-tank, an armored, spider-legged war machine of gnomish make. It now fights those seeking to free Gnomeregan.

angles.text: As an exiled gnome of Ironforge, you may see Electrocutioner 6000 as an insult to your craft: a gnomish war machine turned against its own people under Thermaplugg's rule.
As an engineer, you can marvel at the high-voltage output harnessed within Electrocutioner 6000's chassis, even as it is turned against you.
As an ally, you know breaching the Launch Bay and destroying Electrocutioner 6000 is vital to securing the Workshop Key. It lets you bypass hazardous front corridors while seeking to free Gnomeregan.
